answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 11075 Country: India Title: i put my sons name is ABAAN Ali and daughters name is ANAM. Is it good name? Can you please give me the propper meaning to this name. those name are as per Islamic direction? Question: i put my sons name is ABAAN Ali and daughters name is ANAM. Is it good name? Can you please give me the propper meaning to this name. those name are as per Islamic direction? Answer ID: 11075 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 363/310=D/1430) Abaan is a mount, it has no other meaning, but it is name of a narrator of hadith, while the word Anam has no meaning. One should name after the prophets, Sahabah and Sahabiyat or names which have good meaning; since names also have effects. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
